metadata.case_name: ALI RAFAQAT v. WISE SECURITY LTD AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: SL carpal ligament injury / scapho-lunate ligament injury
source: It showed a widening of the scapho-lunate (“SL”) distance and the diagnosis was SL carpal ligament injury and right thumb metacarpo-phalangeal joint (“MCPJ”) sprain injury.
scarring of the Plaintiff’s right thumb MCPJ with synovitis and tear of the SL ligament were found.

injuries.description: right thumb metacarpo-phalangeal joint (MCPJ) sprain; scarring of MCPJ with synovitis; scar formation and joint arthritis of MCPJ
source: It showed a widening of the scapho-lunate (“SL”) distance and the diagnosis was SL carpal ligament injury and right thumb metacarpo-phalangeal joint (“MCPJ”) sprain injury.
scarring of the Plaintiff’s right thumb MCPJ with synovitis and tear of the SL ligament were found.
Repeated arthroscopic examination was done on 16 October 2007 which showed scar formation and joint arthritis of MCPJ.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of metacarpophalangeal joint of thumb

manifestations.description: Residual tenderness in his right wrist
Residual tenderness in his right thumb
impaired sensation in the ulnar border of the right thumb except the tip
Movements of the right thumb and right wrist were slightly limited
some residual pain and stiffness may remain in the right wrist and right thumb
persistent pain at the base of the right thumb and when pressing against an object with the bottom of his right palm; cannot pick up heavy objects; right hand not strong enough; cannot play cricket
work evaluation showed capable of performing work involving reaching, handling and finger dexterity at all levels but with a below standard rate when compared with industrial standard

source: The Plaintiff attended the Accident & Emergency Department of Tseung Kwan O Hospital on the day of the assault. He was given a dynacast and was discharged on the same day.

treatments_received.treatment: CT scan of the right wrist
source: CT scan of the right wrist was done on 19 May 2006. It showed a widening of the scapho-lunate (“SL”) distance and the diagnosis was SL carpal ligament injury and right thumb metacarpo-phalangeal joint (“MCPJ”) sprain injury.
Splintage was applied and physiotherapy was given.
Splintage was applied and physiotherapy was given.
The Plaintiff then continued his physiotherapy treatment.
The Plaintiff complained of persistent pain and arthroscopic examination was conducted.
Repeated arthroscopic examination was done on 16 October 2007 which showed scar formation and joint arthritis of MCPJ.

treatments_received.treatment: operation for reconstruction of the SL ligament
source: An operation for reconstruction of the SL ligament was done on 20 March 2007 and the Plaintiff then continued his physiotherapy treatment.

treatments_future.treatment: fusion of the proximal carpal row (may be required if pain becomes worse)
source: If pain becomes worse, fusion of the proximal carpal row may be required.

losses.description: Residual tenderness, impaired sensation, limited movement, residual pain and stiffness in the right wrist and right thumb resulting in reduced function of the hand.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: cannot play cricket now as his right hand is not strong enough.
